description: Estimates how much of a self-employed profit to set aside for taxes: set-aside = profit x chosen percent, and the US self-employment tax part = profit x 92.35% x 15.3% (12.4% Social Security + 2.9% Medicare), per month, quarter or year. Same formula as https://profitdrawer.com/tools/self-employed-tax-calculator.html. An estimate, not tax advice.

period.description: The period the profit is for. Default month.

profit.description: Profit (income minus business expenses) for one period, in USD.

set_aside_percent.description: Share of the profit to set aside, in percent, for example 30.

name: calculate_tax_set_aside
title: Calculate self-employed tax set-aside
